description:
Find every note that links TO a target note (inbound references). Supports both wiki-style `[[Note]]` and markdown-style `[text](Note.md)` links. When `includeContext:true`, each result carries a `contextLength`-char snippet of surrounding text so the agent can judge link intent without re-reading each source. Read-only. For outbound links (what a note points AT), use `links.outgoing`.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

contextLength.description: Characters of context per hit. Default 80.

includeContext.description: When true, each result carries a snippet of surrounding text for each backlink.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the note whose inbound links we want.

name: links.backlinks

outputSchema.description: Standard list envelope used by list/search tools.

items.description: List of result items; per-item shape depends on the tool.
Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.

title: Get Backlinks
